I am **Fiona Burlig**, an assistant professor at the Harris School of Public Policy at the University of Chicago, an NBER Faculty Research Fellow (EEE and DEV), an affiliate of J-PAL, BREAD, and the IGC, and Deputy Faculty Director of EPIC-India and the Odisha Data, Policy, and Innovation Centre.

I am an applied microeconomist with research interests in and at the intersection of energy, environmental, and resource economics and development economics. Prior to joining Harris, I was a postdoc in the Department of Economics at the University of Chicago. I hold a PhD in agricultural and resource economics from the University of California, Berkeley, and a BA in economics, political science, and German from Williams College.
